description:
We're Proof, a technology-enabled legal services platform built for the largest and most operationally demanding legal organizations in the country. We work with high-volume creditors’ rights law firms, major debt buyers, and institutional property management operators — helping them serve defendants, file cases, manage affidavits, and navigate complex multi-state jurisdictional requirements through a single national platform.

Our creditors’ rights division, spanning consumer collections, debt buying, and the broader accounts receivable management (ARM) industry is the fastest-growing part of our business. Firms representing many of the largest debt buyers in the country are filing at record volumes in 2026. We are the platform built to support that scale — with jurisdictional rules hard-coded at dispatch, GPS-verified documentation on every job, automated affidavit generation, and SOC 2 Type 2 certification. We are not a referral network. We are a purpose-built operational infrastructure for firms that need to serve tens of thousands of defendants a month with precision and compliance.

About the Role:

We are hiring a Senior Account Executive to lead new business development in our Creditors’ Rights and consumer collections division. This is an enterprise hunter role — you will own the full sales motion from prospecting to close for the largest debt buyers and creditors’ rights law firms in the country. The accounts you are selling into are sophisticated, volume-driven, and relationship-first. They care about compliance, documentation quality, jurisdictional accuracy, and throughput.  

This is not a volume-dial SDR-supported role. You will need to build relationships at the Managing Partner, Director of Operations, and VP of Legal Operations level. Your credibility, your knowledge of the creditors’ rights and debt collection process, and your ability to connect Proof’s platform to their specific operational pain is how you win.

The right person has sold into legal collections, debt buying, or the account receivable management (ARM) industry or a comparably regulated industry requiring complex compliance and documentation. You can speak knowledgeably about the creditors’ rights process and engage a partner at a top creditors’ rights firm as a peer, not as a salesperson.

What You'll Do:

Enterprise Pipeline Development

  • Own a named account list of the highest-priority creditors’ rights law firms and major debt buyers in the country, and the law firms they engage in every state they file
  • Build and execute a strategic outbound motion — executive outreach, industry conference presence, referrals from existing Proof clients, and event-driven cultivation
  • Develop and maintain a 12-18 month pipeline with consistent 45-60 day senior-level touches on all target accounts — when the timing is right, Proof’s name is the one they call

Full-Cycle Enterprise Sales

  • Lead consultative discovery with senior decision makers — Managing Partners, Directors of Operations, Legal Operations leads — to surface workflow bottlenecks, jurisdictional compliance risks, and documentation gaps
  • Navigate multi-stakeholder deals across operations, legal, compliance, and IT — with deal cycles typically ranging from 3-6 months for enterprise accounts
  • Deliver tailored presentations and demos that connect Proof’s platform directly to a firm’s specific state footprint, plaintiff mix, and volume profile
  • Own the commercial negotiation and close, including enterprise pricing, multi-year agreements, volume tier structures
  • Manage a clean, accurate forecast in HubSpot with consistent pipeline hygiene and disciplined stage progression

Account Expansion & Ramp Management

  • Partner with the Account Management team at customer kickoff. Work alongside the Account Manager for the first three quarters, following a mutual success plan that defines committed volume targets, reporting cadence, and ramp milestones.
  • Maintain executive-level relationships within existing accounts to drive volume expansion into new states, new plaintiff types, and new practice areas
  • Partner with the AM team on QBRs and strategic account reviews for your largest accounts

Industry Presence

  • Represent Proof at major creditors’ rights industry events
  • Host executive dinners and private client events in key markets ( to build and deepen relationships with target accounts

What You'll Bring:

Required

  • 5+ years of full-cycle B2B sales experience with at least 3 years selling into creditors’ rights, consumer collections, debt buying, legal services, financial services, or a regulated industry with complex compliance requirements
  • Demonstrated track record of landing and expanding enterprise accounts, deals above $200K annually, 6+ month cycles, multi-stakeholder environments
  • Familiarity with the creditors’ rights and consumer collections ecosystem. You know how major debt buyers work with their law firm partners
  • Understanding of the legal process serving workflow including service of process, affidavit of service, substituted service rules, e-filing, judgment motions — or the demonstrated ability to learn it fast and speak fluently about it within 90 days
  • Executive presence and consultative selling skills. You can hold a meaningful conversation with a Managing Partner or VP of Operations about their actual operational pain, not just a product feature
  • Strong pipeline discipline - you own your number, you build your own outbound, and you keep your CRM accurate without being asked
  • Willingness to travel to industry conferences and client visits. Estimated 20-25% travel

Strongly Preferred

  • Prior experience selling to creditors’ rights law firms, debt buyers, or the ARM industry directly
  • Existing relationships at high-volume creditors’ rights law firms
  • Relationships at major debt buyers
  • Experience with legal technology, process serving platforms, e-filing systems, or case management software
  • Familiarity with state-by-state service of process requirements across your target markets
  • Active presence in national or state creditors’ rights industry and bar associations such as RMAI, ACA International, NCBA. 

Compensation

  • $200,000-$250,000 OTE based on experience, location, and performance

Benefits

  • Full time, remote, salary position
  • Medical, dental, vision, disability insurance, and 401k available
  • Phone and Internet monthly stipend
  • Flexible time off (paid planned and sick time, and paid holidays)

E-Verify

This company participates in E-Verify, for more information view the Participation and Right to Work Posters.
